🔖 **How to switch SANDBOX ↔ PRODUCTION**
1) Disconnect **Config (W4) — SANDBOX** → **Validate & Normalize W4 Input**.
2) Connect **Config (W4) — PRODUCTION** → **Validate & Normalize W4 Input**.
3) For Lulu submission:
   • Enable **Lulu PRODUCTION: Get Token → Extract Lulu Access Token (PRODUCTION) → Submit Lulu Print Job (PRODUCTION - BEARER)**.
   • Disable **Lulu SANDBOX: Get Token → Extract Lulu Access Token (SANDBOX) → Submit Lulu Print Job (SANDBOX - BEARER)**.
4) (Optional) To use BASIC (not recommended), enable **Submit Lulu Print Job (PRODUCTION - BASIC)**.
The **Status Banner** node logs which path ran and token timings.

• Make sure **CONFIG.defaults.podPackageId** is set to the correct Lulu SKU before submitting print jobs.


**Tip:** When testing token nodes, use *Execute previous nodes* so the node has `$json.CONFIG` to resolve expressions. Otherwise headers may appear as `undefined`.
